capabilities.description: Managers can set up rink sessions, keep them in schedule order, put held sessions back on sale and cancel them. The public can browse the published schedule.
capabilities.name: Skating session scheduling

capabilities.description: Customers can buy tickets for a skating session at the right price, without overselling. Bookings are recorded per session, and unpaid bookings are released once their payment window runs out.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and booking management

capabilities.description: Works out how many places are left in a session and how many hire skates are free. Capacity is reduced when club bookings block part of the rink.
capabilities.name: Session availability and capacity control

capabilities.description: Keeps a fixed stock of hire skates for each shoe size and reserves them as part of ticket bookings.
capabilities.name: Skate hire inventory

capabilities.description: Customers pay for bookings through an external payment provider (PuckPay). Payment results settle bookings, and tickets are refunded when a session is cancelled.
capabilities.name: Online payment and refunds

capabilities.description: Members get free sessions as part of their membership when they buy tickets.
capabilities.name: Membership free-session entitlement
